title: Cognitive successor Ticket #1 non-governing method lifecycle
description: Shape validation for the non-governing Ticket #1 method-bootstrap lifecycle only. Every lifecycle artifact, including authorization and its acceptance receipt, must first be decoded as UTF-8 by a duplicate-member-aware raw JSON loader that rejects duplicate object names before semantic parsing. This schema cannot prove cross-file hashes, dependency closure, set partitions, actor independence, arithmetic contracts, authorization validity, or legal state transitions; detached executable verifiers must recompute those facts from exact whole-file bytes.

rfc3339_datetime.$comment: The pattern supplies fail-closed lexical validation when an implementation lacks a date-time format checker; the detached verifier must still perform calendar-valid RFC 3339 parsing.

rationale.const: The method can shape safety, cognition, migration, public Interfaces and later irreversible decisions; use HIGH until a new exact question generation proves a narrower scope.

EXACT_WHOLE_FILE_HASH_RECOMPUTATION.const: Recompute every declared SHA-256, including the ticket schema and dependency bundle members, from referenced whole-file raw bytes; never trust embedded or copied digest text.

ARTIFACT_DAG_AND_DEPENDENCY_CLOSURE.const: Rebuild the typed artifact DAG and exact dependency bundle; reject missing, extra, cyclic, stale, ambiguously rooted, role-mismatched, type-mismatched or key-mismatched dependencies; prove selected candidate, selected method, final method and bundle method identity equality; for typed method generation greater than one prove the predecessor has the same method key and exactly the preceding generation, while generation one has null typed supersedes and any legacy untyped predecessor remains context only.

CONSTRAINT_PARTITION_COMPLETENESS.const: For every candidate, prove each protocol-owned hard-constraint key occurs exactly once across PASS, FAIL, BLOCKING_UNKNOWN, and NOT_APPLICABLE, verify every NOT_APPLICABLE justification, exclude every inadmissible candidate from the feasible set, and prove every frozen tradeoff axis assesses all five candidates exactly once.

ACTOR_IDENTITY_AND_DEPENDENCY_SEPARATION.const: Verify producer, challenger, finalizer and verifier identities plus material dependency disclosures from bound identity evidence; declarations and reviewer counts do not prove independence, and required roles must be pairwise separated where declared.

LIFECYCLE_STATE_TRANSITION_VALIDITY.const: Recompute the producer-to-challenger-to-final-candidate-to-dependency-bundle-to-post-final-verifier transition; structural eligibility requires challenger PASS, selected candidate feasible and non-dominated, zero FAIL, zero BLOCKING_UNKNOWN, zero unresolved required evidence gaps and unchanged exact bytes. A pre-authorization verifier must not claim to validate future authorization bytes.

QUALITY_POLICY_CONTRACT_DETERMINISM.const: Recompute metric normalization, target-range distance, interval and margin ordering, exclusive state precedence, exact all-material outcome and cross-domain denominator equality, complexity-fact membership and effect states, and local-guardrail exact PASS semantics; any null, unfrozen, missing, extra, duplicate, stale, arithmetically inconsistent or non-single-valued quality input blocks the corresponding verdict.

EXACT_AUTHORIZATION_AND_DEPENDENCY_HASH_.const: Decode every authorization-stage artifact as UTF-8 with a duplicate-member-aware raw JSON loader that rejects duplicate object names before parsing; recompute authorization_text.exact_text_sha256 from the exact UTF-8 text; then recompute the exact authorization, ticket schema, final record, challenger report, structural verifier report, dependency bundle, selected method, principal, authentication evidence and recovery-boundary hashes from whole-file raw bytes.

AUTHORIZED_METHOD_AND_LIFECYCLE_IDENTITY.const: Prove the authorized method bytes and key equal the final selected method and dependency-bundle method, and that the authorization binds the same final, challenger, verifier and bundle bytes accepted by the lifecycle.

PRINCIPAL_AUTHENTICATION_AND_SCOPE_VALID.const: Verify from bound external identity evidence that the principal is authenticated, currently authorized for the exact method-only scope and distinct from the detached authorization-acceptance gate actor.

ACTION_SCOPE_PROHIBITION_AND_RECOVERY_VA.const: Verify the allowed action and authorized scope are exact, every prohibited action is present, the recovery boundary exists and is applicable, and no production, constitution-clause or legacy-runtime authority is implied.

CALENDAR_WINDOW_EXPIRY_AND_USE_TIME_VALI.const: Parse calendar-valid RFC 3339 times; prove valid_from is earlier than expires_at; prove evaluated_at is within that interval using the bound trusted time source; prove the acceptance receipt valid_until does not exceed the authorization expires_at; and require every use to revalidate both the authorization and receipt windows.

metric_contract.$comment: Cross-field arithmetic, interval ordering, margin ordering, target-range normalization and the exclusive derived state must be recomputed by an executable verifier; JSON Schema validates only the declared fields and constants.

complexity_fact_contract.$comment: The executable quality verifier must recompute denominator membership, baseline-minus-candidate effect, interval and exclusive state; JSON Schema alone cannot prove the arithmetic or source evidence.

const.LEGACY_CERTIFYING_RELEASE: Parity, performance and operational comparison against the exact approved legacy release.
const.HUMAN_ONLY: Cognitive task outcome without AI assistance.
const.SYSTEM_ONLY: Cognitive task outcome without user collaboration.
const.HUMAN_AI_JOINT: Joint cognition outcome for complementarity and appropriate-reliance claims.
const.APPROVED_TASK_SPECIFIC: A separately justified exact baseline for a scoped metric only.

const.TYPED_ERROR_SEMANTICS: Public errors and recovery obligations remain explicit and testable.
const.DUPLICATE_LOGIC: Material duplicated decision, validation, retry or effect logic is measured and cannot hide behind lower file count.
const.PUBLIC_INTERFACE_CONFORMANCE_STABILITY: Interface fixtures remain stable across implementation replacement.
const.READABILITY_AND_MAINTAINABILITY: Independent review covers naming, cohesion, control flow and change-locality without using LOC as a sole oracle.
const.STATIC_AND_DYNAMIC_SAFETY: Required static, dynamic, fault and recovery checks cannot be deleted to lower measured complexity.

design_adjudication_method_candidate.$comment: The detached verifier must prove method_instance_id encodes the declared method_key and generation. For generation greater than one it must also prove prior_method_key equals method_key, prior_generation equals generation minus one, and prior_method_instance_id encodes that exact predecessor. JSON Schema cannot enforce those cross-field equalities.

tradeoff_result_catalog.$comment: Every frozen axis assesses all five candidates; producer-specific one-candidate axes are unrepresentable.

bound_claims.$comment: These are claims signed by the authorization principal, not machine proof. The downstream detached acceptance gate must recompute every claim from bound bytes and external identity and time evidence.

invalidation_conditions.$comment: The downstream authorization acceptance gate must prove valid_from < expires_at, evaluated_at in range, and calendar-valid RFC 3339 timestamps, and consumers must repeat the time check at each use.
